summary: End-to-end testing of the new Customer Expo/RN app on http://localhost:3001 against the shared FastAPI backend. Backend sanity (14 pytest cases) all pass. Frontend Playwright covered: login screen, phone validation, OTP prefill/resend, role restriction (partner blocked), customer login → home dashboard, stats/wallet/refunds, categories & popular services, refer promo, recent bookings, search dropdown, bottom nav placeholder pages, More sheet + logout, notification panel, theme toggle, and session persistence via reload. All acceptance criteria met.

ui_bugs.issue: After a partner/merchant is blocked with the correct 'Only Customers can sign in...' toast and token cleared, the UI remains on OTP step 2 (still shows 'Enter the 6-digit code sent to +91xxx' and OTP boxes) instead of resetting to the phone-entry step. User must click 'Change number' to re-enter a different phone. Not blocking (data-testid login-phone-input reappears after Change number, no token leak) but slightly poor UX.
ui_bugs.selector: [data-testid="login-phone-input"] not visible after failed non-customer verify

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid 'demo-customer' is present in DOM (card visible in screenshot with text 'Login as Customer / Opens Customer account') but Playwright's is_visible() returned False on initial check — likely the testID is attached to a non-hit-testable inner View. Consider moving testID to the outer Pressable/TouchableOpacity so is_visible() and clicks resolve deterministically.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) After finish() rejects a non-customer role in Customer/app/login.tsx, also reset the local OTP UI back to step 1 (phone entry) so the login-phone-input becomes visible again without requiring 'Change number' click.
(Optional/LOW) Move the demo-customer testID from an inner element to the outermost Pressable/TouchableOpacity so it is reliably visible/clickable via data-testid.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.refresh() correctly drops tokens whose /auth/me returns role != customer — verified: partner token is cleared and login remains.

CustomerDataContext polls every 8s — during initial home load, stats reflect real backend counts (total=6, completed=2, active=3, wallet ₹250, refunds ₹0) matching /api/bookings & /api/wallet output; badge count '3' matches active count.
OTP entry uses a hidden RN TextInput with 6 display boxes; boxes correctly show prefilled dev_otp 123456 as text content (not input value).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of acceptance criteria (13/13 assertions passed; 2 minor UX observations)

test_credentials: Customer 9000000004 (Priya Verma) OTP 123456; Partner 9000000003, Merchant 9000000002, Admin 9000000000 all OTP 123456 (blocked in Customer app).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo seed users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer app is the Expo web build on port 3001 managed by supervisor program 'customer_expo'. All RN testID attributes surface as data-testid on web. OTP boxes are Views — read via text_content, not input_value. Backend uses local http://localhost:8001. Session persists via localStorage 'azo_token' (persists after page.reload in same context). Role guard is enforced both by AuthContext.refresh() and finish() in login.tsx. Non-customer roles are rejected with toast 'Only Customers can sign in to the Customer App...' — verified working.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Two low-priority UX polish observations noted for main agent.
